name: Lionel Messi
role: Argentine footballer, captain of Argentina (2022 World Cup winner)
summary: Messi has largely kept out of politics and says he does not like talking about it, comparing political parties to rival football teams. His few socially oriented remarks, made in a 2020 interview with an Argentine community magazine, call inequality a major problem that must be corrected, stress education, and call for essential services to be protected for the needy during the pandemic. None of these remarks takes a position on a specific policy.

notes: Every answer is null. His 2020 remarks that inequality should be corrected and that essential services should be preserved for the needy are too general to place him on any specific statement (e.g. tax-the-wealthy, equal-outcomes, universal-healthcare). He avoided taking sides on Catalan independence. Appearing at the Trump White House in 2026 with Inter Miami, and declining to visit the Argentine president after the 2022 World Cup, are not statements of political position.
